meta.source: REGULAR shots in data/processed/all_shots.parquet joined to data/raw_shots_*.parquet on (GAME_ID, GAME_EVENT_ID)
meta.selection_rule: Draw 300 real REGULAR shots without replacement using numpy.random.default_rng(42); if |mean_p_a_sample - mean_p_a_zone| > 0.003, redraw with 1000 rows.

mirror_diagnostic.note: Audit diagnostic on a single polar-consistent point (information only; presets use real-shot samples).
mirror_diagnostic.side_rule: Side with more shots in the zone (ties to left); center for putback.
